sentence.en: Websites, custom software and automation, engineered to last.

set.name: Layers
set.mechanism: Phase 1's segmented E, given depth: a neutral spine and three separate slabs, sheared upward and stepping from cyan through blue to violet. Layers of a system, built one on another, with the gradient made of flat steps.
set.expression_move: The three-step colour ramp across the slabs.
set.differs_by: Isometric layer marks are common in cloud and dev tools; this one keeps the gaps and the short middle arm, so it reads as E first and stack second.

logo.concept: Three slabs of a system stacked into an E, cyan to violet in flat steps.

defaults_used.why: Client palette: violet is requested and used as the last step of the mark's ramp, not as a primary.

rationale.claim: Client direction from reference images: layered E, cyan-to-violet.
The gradient is quantised into three flat steps, so the master works in print, embroidery and one colour; a smooth gradient is an optional digital treatment.
